svg.title: Recruitment Agent — Full Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: LangGraph pipeline showing all nodes from email trigger through classifier, ingest, screening, judge, HITL, audit, routing and scheduling, with Supabase and web UI as supporting systems

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Gmail poller detect new CV emails?')
sendPrompt('What does the classifier node do — CV detection and JD matching?')
g.text: Detect CV · match email to JD · MIME check

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens when no CV is found in the email?')
sendPrompt('What does the ingest node extract from the CV?')
g.text: Parse CV · extract CandidateData · create pipeline run

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the screening node score candidates against JD criteria?')
sendPrompt('How does the judge node critique the screener output field by field?')
sendPrompt('How does the HITL node pause the pipeline and notify HR?')
g.text: Pipeline pauses · notification email sent to HR

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the audit node write to Excel and Supabase?')
g.text: Append Excel row · update Supabase · mark done

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens to rejected or hold candidates after audit?')
sendPrompt('How does the routing node forward the profile to the department head?')
g.text: Email profile + CV to dept head

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How will the scheduling node book Google Calendar interview slots?')
